text_block_list.text: "Chrono Genesis got injured, so I rushed her to the infirmary, but—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for a while, Chrono.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, wait...! First aid is already done, so I can get back to training...!
At least let me do some light work...!
choice_data_list: No way, I can't allow that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...The time an Umamusume has
to weave her drama on the turf is limited...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have followed history so closely,
I cannot look away from it now.
That is why...!"
choice_data_list: That is precisely why I cannot give permission.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have followed history so closely,
I cannot look away from it now.
That is why...!"
choice_data_list: That is precisely why I cannot give permission.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Why... is this happening... I... ngh.
choice_data_list: I know the history too, after all.
Because I know the history, too.

text_block_list.text:
Some girls have overcome injuries to make a glorious comeback.
Yet many more pushed too hard and ended their athletic careers—I spoke, striving to remain calm.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That... may be true, but...
choice_data_list: I don't want to crush Chrono's dream.
I don't want Chrono's dream to be crushed.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...
To be honest, my anxiety hasn't vanished, but... even so—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern.
I must stay calm and look toward the future... right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure the history of racing I aspire to does not end...
For now, I will concentrate on treatment."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To carve out a glorious history, we must never stop moving forward... right?!
choice_data_list: Please, make sure not to push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...U-Understood.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
That's all for today...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: No overdoing it... That's a promise, after all.

Taking her along as she winced in pain,
you wrapped up the training session early.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! This is...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I can't put it into words very well, but... it feels like my horizons have broadened compared to before...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Footwork and pacing...
By moving with my injury in mind,
I feel like I might grasp a sensation I've never had before...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'm going for one more lap...!

"‘A blessing in disguise’, perhaps—
Watching Chrono Genesis walk away,
those were the thoughts in my mind."
